content.comment_body: Hello, I'm currently working with [product_name] [version_no], but I haven't determined how to change values on the web server page. Sometimes a pop-up appears and other times it does not (see image). Another issue is displaying the status of all I/O modules. The message text module shows digital inputs only up to number 10, though I have 12 total digital inputs. Thanks.

The pop-up will show only when you display parameters of blocks within a message text, and these can be changed via the device interface. Regarding your number of inputs, I'm not quite sure what you mean.

Hi, thanks for your reply. I've added the parameters to the message text, but on the web server page, I don't always see the pop-up. Should I double-click, or is there a specific area to click for the parameter? I resolved the issue with inputs—they didn't appear in the list because they weren't included in the project yet. Thanks.
Parameters that can be changed on the web server are shown in blue. To open the pop-up window, double-click the relevant parameter in the web interface.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report inconsistent behavior when trying to change parameter values via the web interface for [product_name] [version_no]. There is confusion about when and how pop-ups for modifying values appear, causing uncertainty about user actions. Separately, a user resolved an issue with displaying all digital inputs. The main feedback points to challenges with the clarity and usability of key interface elements.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a clear and reliable method for modifying values in the web interface, including the consistent appearance of modals or pop-ups. They also want simple and complete visualization of all I/O module states, with no restrictions on the number of displayed inputs.
